docs.title: Acceptable Use Policy
docs.text:
Freelancer Digest

Effective Date: August 2, 2026 Last Updated: August 2, 2026

This Acceptable Use Policy ("Policy") defines prohibited and restricted uses of Freelancer Digest ("Service", "Platform", "we", "our", or "us").

This Policy forms part of the Freelancer Digest Terms of Service.

docs.title: 1. General Requirements
docs.text:
You may use Freelancer Digest only for lawful purposes and in accordance with:

  • these Terms;
  • this Acceptable Use Policy;
  • applicable laws and regulations;
  • applicable third-party platform rules.

You are responsible for your use of the Service and for any activity performed through your account.

docs.title: 2. Prohibited Activities
docs.text:
You must not use the Service to:

  • violate applicable laws or regulations;
  • infringe intellectual property, privacy, or other rights of third parties;
  • engage in fraud, deception, or misrepresentation;
  • impersonate another person or organization;
  • distribute malware, malicious code, or other harmful software;
  • attempt to gain unauthorized access to the Service or related systems;
  • interfere with the availability, integrity, or security of the Service;
  • intentionally introduce vulnerabilities or exploit security weaknesses;
  • bypass authentication, access controls, subscription restrictions, or payment mechanisms;
  • use the Service to facilitate unauthorized access to third-party systems;
  • use the Service for activities that may reasonably cause harm to other users or third parties.

docs.title: 3. Abuse of the Service
docs.text:
You must not intentionally abuse the infrastructure or functionality of the Service.

Prohibited activities include:

  • excessive automated requests;
  • deliberate resource exhaustion;
  • denial-of-service activity;
  • attempts to circumvent rate limits;
  • automated activity intended to degrade Service performance;
  • unauthorized scraping or extraction of Service data;
  • attempts to interfere with databases, APIs, queues, caches, or other infrastructure;
  • exploiting bugs or vulnerabilities without authorization.

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it to us rather than attempting to exploit it.

docs.title: 4. Subscription and Payment Abuse
docs.text:
You must not:

  • circumvent Premium access controls;
  • share Premium access with unauthorized users;
  • manipulate payment confirmations;
  • attempt to obtain Premium Features without valid payment;
  • abuse refund mechanisms;
  • submit fraudulent payment or refund claims;
  • exploit technical errors to obtain paid functionality without authorization.

We may suspend or terminate access where we reasonably believe that payment or subscription mechanisms are being abused.

docs.title: 5. Content and Communications
docs.text:
You must not use the Service to distribute or facilitate content that is unlawful or intended to cause harm.

This includes content that:

  • promotes illegal activity;
  • contains malicious software;
  • intentionally facilitates fraud or deception;
  • infringes third-party rights;
  • contains unauthorized personal or confidential information;
  • is intended to compromise the security of systems or accounts.

We are not responsible for content originating from third-party freelance platforms or other external sources.

docs.title: 6. Third-Party Platforms
docs.text:
Freelancer Digest may aggregate, process, classify, or provide links to information originating from third-party freelance platforms.

Your use of those platforms remains subject to their respective terms, policies, and restrictions.

You must not use Freelancer Digest to circumvent restrictions imposed by a third-party platform.

You are responsible for ensuring that your activities comply with the applicable rules of any third-party platform you access through the Service.

docs.title: 7. Automated Access
docs.text:
You must not use bots, scripts, crawlers, scrapers, or other automated mechanisms to interact with Freelancer Digest in a manner that:

  • bypasses technical restrictions;
  • circumvents rate limits;
  • creates excessive load;
  • interferes with normal Service operation;
  • attempts to access functionality not intended for automated use.

Any authorized API or integration must be used in accordance with its applicable documentation and limitations.

docs.title: 8. Security Research
docs.text:
Good-faith security research is not prohibited where it is conducted responsibly and does not compromise the Service or user data.

You must not:

  • access data belonging to other users;
  • modify or delete data;
  • interrupt or degrade the Service;
  • disclose vulnerabilities publicly before providing us with a reasonable opportunity to address them;
  • use a vulnerability for personal gain or unauthorized access.

If you identify a potential security issue, contact us using the support information provided on our legal website.

docs.title: 9. Enforcement
docs.text:
We may investigate suspected violations of this Policy.

Where appropriate, we may:

  • issue warnings;
  • restrict functionality;
  • temporarily suspend an account;
  • terminate an account;
  • revoke Premium access;
  • investigate suspicious transactions;
  • preserve relevant information where legally permitted or required;
  • take other reasonable measures necessary to protect the Service and its users.

We are not required to provide advance notice where immediate action is reasonably necessary to protect the Service, users, or third parties.

docs.title: 10. Reporting Violations
docs.text:
If you believe that another user is violating this Policy or abusing the Service, you may report the issue to us.

Reports should include enough information to allow us to understand and investigate the alleged violation.

Do not include unnecessary sensitive personal information in your report.

docs.title: 11. Relationship with the Terms of Service
docs.text:
This Policy forms part of the Freelancer Digest Terms of Service.

A violation of this Policy constitutes a violation of the Terms of Service and may result in suspension or termination of access.

If there is a conflict between this Policy and the Terms of Service, the Terms of Service will govern unless this Policy expressly states otherwise.

docs.title: 12. Changes to this Policy
docs.text:
We may update this Policy from time to time to reflect:

  • changes to the Service;
  • changes to our security practices;
  • new functionality;
  • changes in applicable law;
  • changes in third-party integrations.

The current version will be published on our official legal website.

docs.title: 13. Contact Information
docs.text:
Questions or reports concerning this Policy may be submitted to:

Freelancer Digest

Email: wagnyjagare91@gmail.com

Legal Website: https://freelancer-digest-legal.github.io/

You may also contact us through the official Freelancer Digest Telegram Bot.

docs.title: 14. Effective Date
docs.text:
This Acceptable Use Policy is effective as of August 2, 2026.

Last Updated: August 2, 2026

docs.title: Billing & Refund Policy
docs.text:
Freelancer Digest

Effective Date: August 2, 2026 Last Updated: August 2, 2026

This Billing & Refund Policy explains how payments, Premium Subscriptions, billing, cancellations, and refunds are handled by Freelancer Digest ("Service", "Platform", "we", "our", or "us").

This Policy forms part of the Freelancer Digest Terms of Service.

docs.title: 1. Payments
docs.text:
Freelancer Digest currently accepts payments for Premium Subscriptions through Telegram Stars.

When you purchase a Premium Subscription, the payment is processed through Telegram's payment infrastructure.

We do not directly collect or store your payment card details, bank account information, or other payment credentials.

Your use of Telegram Stars is also subject to Telegram's applicable terms and policies.

docs.title: 2. Subscription Plans
docs.text:
The Service may offer one or more Premium Subscription Plans.

Each Subscription Plan may specify:

  • subscription duration;
  • price;
  • included Premium Features;
  • applicable conditions.

The applicable price and subscription conditions are displayed to you before you confirm a purchase.

We reserve the right to introduce, modify, or discontinue Subscription Plans.

Changes to existing subscriptions will be handled in accordance with applicable law and the Terms of Service.

docs.title: 3. Payment Confirmation
docs.text:
A Premium Subscription is activated only after the Service receives and successfully verifies the relevant payment confirmation.

A payment being initiated or displayed as pending does not by itself guarantee Premium access.

If payment confirmation cannot be verified, Premium access may not be activated until the payment status is successfully confirmed.

docs.title: 4. Premium Activation
docs.text:
After successful payment verification, the corresponding Premium Subscription is associated with your Freelancer Digest account.

Premium Features become available for the applicable subscription period.

The subscription period begins according to the subscription information displayed at the time of purchase and recorded by the Service after successful payment confirmation.

docs.title: 5. Subscription Expiration
docs.text:
Premium access automatically expires when the applicable subscription period ends unless the Service provides a renewal mechanism.

After expiration:

  • Premium Features may become unavailable;
  • your account may continue to exist;
  • information associated with your account may remain subject to our Privacy Policy.

Expiration of a subscription does not require deletion of your account.

docs.title: 6. Cancellation
docs.text:
If the Service provides a subscription cancellation mechanism, you may use that mechanism to cancel future renewal of your subscription.

Cancellation of a subscription does not necessarily result in an immediate termination of already-paid Premium access.

Unless otherwise required by applicable law or expressly stated at the time of purchase, cancellation generally prevents future charges or renewals rather than creating an automatic entitlement to a refund for the current subscription period.

docs.title: 7. Refunds
docs.text:
Because payments are made using Telegram Stars, refunds are subject to the payment mechanisms and applicable rules governing those transactions.

Where a refund is available, requests may be submitted through Freelancer Digest support.

Unless required by applicable law, refunds are not guaranteed for:

  • change of mind;
  • unused Premium Features;
  • failure to use the Service;
  • partial use of a subscription period;
  • failure to configure notifications or preferences;
  • inability to obtain freelance work through the Service.

We may consider refund requests on a case-by-case basis where appropriate.

Nothing in this Policy limits mandatory refund or consumer rights provided by applicable law.

docs.title: 8. Duplicate or Incorrect Payments
docs.text:
If you believe that you have been charged more than once for the same subscription or that a payment was processed incorrectly, please contact support as soon as reasonably possible.

We may request information necessary to identify the relevant transaction, such as:

  • Telegram user identifier;
  • transaction identifier;
  • approximate payment date;
  • Subscription Plan;
  • other information reasonably necessary to investigate the issue.

We will review the transaction and, where appropriate, take reasonable steps to resolve verified billing errors.

docs.title: 9. Failed Payments
docs.text:
If a payment fails, is rejected, cancelled, or cannot be verified, Premium access may not be activated.

If Premium access was granted before a payment was subsequently determined to be invalid or reversed, we may suspend or terminate the associated Premium access.

docs.title: 10. Fraud and Unauthorized Transactions
docs.text:
We may investigate transactions that appear to involve:

  • fraud;
  • unauthorized activity;
  • payment manipulation;
  • abuse of refunds;
  • attempts to circumvent subscription mechanisms.

Where reasonably necessary, we may suspend Premium access while a transaction is being investigated.

We may also terminate accounts involved in fraudulent or abusive activity in accordance with the Terms of Service.

docs.title: 11. Taxes and Additional Charges
docs.text:
The amount displayed at the time of purchase may be affected by taxes, fees, or other charges imposed by Telegram or applicable authorities.

Where applicable, such amounts may be determined by the payment provider or relevant jurisdiction.

You are responsible for any taxes or obligations that may apply to your use of the Service, except for taxes that Freelancer Digest is legally required to collect and remit.

docs.title: 12. Changes to Pricing
docs.text:
We may change the prices or terms of Subscription Plans from time to time.

Any applicable price will be displayed before you confirm a new purchase.

Unless required by applicable law, changes to pricing do not retroactively modify the amount already paid for an active subscription period.

docs.title: 13. Payment Provider
docs.text:
Telegram Stars and related payment functionality are provided through Telegram and its payment infrastructure.

Freelancer Digest does not control the underlying Telegram payment infrastructure.

Issues concerning the operation of Telegram Stars may be subject to Telegram's own policies and technical procedures.

Where a payment issue can only be resolved by Telegram or another payment provider, we may direct you to the applicable provider.

docs.title: 14. No Guarantee of Earnings
docs.text:
Purchasing a Premium Subscription does not guarantee that you will obtain freelance work, clients, contracts, revenue, or any particular financial result.

Freelancer Digest provides software functionality intended to help users discover and evaluate freelance opportunities.

Any decision to apply for a project, contact a client, submit a proposal, or enter into a contract is made solely by you.

docs.title: 15. Contact and Billing Support
docs.text:
For billing questions, payment problems, refund requests, or subscription-related issues, contact:

Freelancer Digest

Email: wagnyjagare91@gmail.com

Legal Website: https://freelancer-digest-legal.github.io/

When contacting support regarding a payment, please provide sufficient information to identify the transaction.

Do not send passwords, private keys, payment card numbers, or other unnecessary sensitive information.

docs.title: 16. Changes to this Policy
docs.text:
We may update this Billing & Refund Policy from time to time to reflect changes in:

  • payment providers;
  • Telegram Stars functionality;
  • Subscription Plans;
  • pricing;
  • refund procedures;
  • applicable laws;
  • the Service.

The current version will be published on our official legal website.

Where required by applicable law, we may provide additional notice of material changes.

docs.title: 17. Relationship with the Terms of Service
docs.text:
This Policy forms part of the Freelancer Digest Terms of Service.

If there is a conflict between this Policy and the Terms of Service, the Terms of Service will govern unless this Policy expressly states otherwise.

Mandatory rights granted to consumers under applicable law remain unaffected.

docs.title: 18. Effective Date
docs.text:
This Billing & Refund Policy is effective as of August 2, 2026.

Last Updated: August 2, 2026

docs.title: Disclaimer
docs.text:
Freelancer Digest

Effective Date: August 2, 2026 Last Updated: August 2, 2026

This Disclaimer explains the limitations of the information and functionality provided by Freelancer Digest ("Service", "Platform", "we", "our", or "us").

By using the Service, you acknowledge and agree to the limitations described below.

docs.title: 1. Informational Service
docs.text:
Freelancer Digest is a software service designed to help freelancers discover and evaluate freelance opportunities.

The Service may aggregate, filter, classify, rank, and recommend opportunities based on information obtained from external sources and user preferences.

Freelancer Digest does not constitute an employment agency, recruitment agency, staffing agency, legal adviser, financial adviser, or other professional adviser unless expressly stated otherwise.

docs.title: 2. No Guarantee of Results
docs.text:
Use of Freelancer Digest does not guarantee:

  • finding a freelance project;
  • receiving an invitation or response from a client;
  • winning a project;
  • obtaining employment;
  • generating revenue;
  • achieving any particular financial result.

Any decision to apply for an opportunity or enter into an agreement with a client is made solely by you.

docs.title: 3. Third-Party Opportunities
docs.text:
Freelancer Digest may provide information about opportunities originating from third-party platforms or other external sources.

We do not control:

  • the availability of third-party opportunities;
  • the accuracy of third-party listings;
  • client requirements;
  • project budgets;
  • client decisions;
  • competition between freelancers;
  • the terms of contracts offered by third parties.

An opportunity displayed by Freelancer Digest may become unavailable, change, or be removed by its original source.

You should independently verify important information before relying on it.

docs.title: 4. Automated Processing
docs.text:
The Service may use automated algorithms, classification systems, matching mechanisms, and other technical processes to analyze and rank opportunities.

Automated results may contain errors or may not accurately reflect your individual circumstances.

A recommendation or ranking should therefore be treated as an informational aid rather than a definitive assessment of whether an opportunity is suitable for you.

docs.title: 5. Accuracy of Information
docs.text:
We make reasonable efforts to provide useful and relevant information, but we do not guarantee that all information provided through the Service is:

  • complete;
  • accurate;
  • current;
  • error-free;
  • available at all times.

Information originating from third parties may contain inaccuracies that are outside our control.

You are responsible for independently verifying information that is important to your decisions.

docs.title: 6. No Professional Advice
docs.text:
Information provided through Freelancer Digest does not constitute:

  • legal advice;
  • tax advice;
  • accounting advice;
  • financial advice;
  • employment advice;
  • immigration advice;
  • professional consulting advice.

You should seek appropriate professional advice where necessary.

docs.title: 7. External Links and Services
docs.text:
The Service may contain links, references, or integrations to third-party websites, platforms, services, or applications.

We do not control and are not responsible for:

  • third-party content;
  • third-party availability;
  • third-party privacy practices;
  • third-party security;
  • third-party terms;
  • transactions between you and third parties.

Your use of third-party services is governed by the applicable third-party terms and policies.

docs.title: 8. User Decisions
docs.text:
You remain solely responsible for decisions made based on information obtained through the Service.

This includes decisions concerning:

  • whether to apply for a project;
  • whether to contact a client;
  • whether to accept an offer;
  • pricing and negotiation;
  • entering into contracts;
  • sharing information with third parties;
  • performing freelance work.

Freelancer Digest is not a party to agreements between freelancers and clients unless expressly stated otherwise.

docs.title: 9. Availability
docs.text:
We do not guarantee that the Service will always be available or operate without interruption.

The Service may be affected by:

  • maintenance;
  • technical failures;
  • third-party outages;
  • network problems;
  • security incidents;
  • changes to external platforms;
  • circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

docs.title: 10. No Warranty
docs.text:
To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, the Service and all information provided through it are provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis.

We disclaim warranties to the extent permitted by law, including warranties concerning accuracy, availability, suitability, reliability, and fitness for a particular purpose.

Nothing in this Disclaimer excludes or limits rights or warranties that cannot legally be excluded or limited.

docs.title: 11. Limitation of Liability
docs.text:
To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Freelancer Digest shall not be responsible for losses or damages arising from reliance on information, recommendations, rankings, or other content provided through the Service.

This includes, without limitation:

  • missed opportunities;
  • lost contracts;
  • lost revenue;
  • unsuccessful applications;
  • inaccurate recommendations;
  • third-party actions;
  • changes to external opportunities.

Any applicable limitation of liability is further described in the Terms of Service.

docs.title: 12. Changes to this Disclaimer
docs.text:
We may update this Disclaimer from time to time to reflect changes to:

  • the Service;
  • our functionality;
  • third-party integrations;
  • applicable laws;
  • our business operations.

The current version will be published on our official legal website.

docs.title: Privacy Policy
docs.text:
Freelancer Digest

Effective Date: August 2, 2026 Last Updated: August 2, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Freelancer Digest ("Service", "Platform", "we", "our", or "us") collects, uses, stores, and otherwise processes information in connection with your use of the Service.

By using Freelancer Digest, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

docs.title: 1. Scope
docs.text:
This Privacy Policy applies to information processed in connection with:

  • the Freelancer Digest Telegram bot;
  • the Freelancer Digest website;
  • user accounts;
  • Premium Subscriptions;
  • payment-related information;
  • notifications and recommendations;
  • customer support; and
  • other services provided by Freelancer Digest.

This Privacy Policy does not apply to third-party services that you may access through Freelancer Digest. Such services have their own privacy policies and terms.

docs.title: 2. Information We Collect
docs.text: We collect only information that is reasonably necessary to provide, maintain, secure, and improve the Service.

docs.title: 2.1 Telegram Account Information
docs.text:
When you use Freelancer Digest through Telegram, we may receive information made available to us through Telegram's platform and API.

This may include:

  • Telegram user identifier;
  • Telegram username;
  • display name;
  • language or locale information, where provided;
  • information necessary to communicate with you through Telegram.

We do not request your Telegram password.

We do not have access to your Telegram account credentials.

docs.title: 2.2 Service Usage Information
docs.text:
We may collect information about how you interact with the Service.

This may include:

  • features used;
  • commands and interactions with the Telegram bot;
  • subscription status;
  • selected preferences;
  • notification settings;
  • technical events;
  • error and diagnostic information; and
  • information necessary to maintain service security and reliability.

docs.title: 2.3 Subscription and Billing Information
docs.text:
When you purchase a Premium Subscription, we may process information necessary to identify and maintain your subscription.

This may include:

  • subscription identifier;
  • selected Subscription Plan;
  • payment status;
  • transaction identifier;
  • purchase date;
  • subscription start and expiration dates;
  • refund or cancellation status.

Payments are currently processed through Telegram Stars.

We do not collect or store your payment card number, bank account information, or other payment credentials through the Service.

Payment information is processed by the applicable payment provider in accordance with its own terms and privacy policy.

docs.title: 2.4 Support Communications
docs.text:
If you contact us for support, we may process information contained in your communication.

This may include:

  • your Telegram identifier;
  • contact information you voluntarily provide;
  • the contents of your support request;
  • technical information necessary to investigate an issue.

We use this information to respond to your request and provide support.

docs.title: 3. How We Use Information
docs.text: We may use information for the following purposes:

docs.title: 3.1 Providing the Service
docs.text:
We use information to:

  • authenticate users;
  • provide access to the Service;
  • deliver freelance opportunity notifications;
  • provide recommendations;
  • maintain subscription status;
  • provide Premium Features;
  • communicate with users.

docs.title: 3.2 Billing and Subscription Management
docs.text:
We use relevant information to:

  • verify payments;
  • activate Premium Subscriptions;
  • determine subscription status;
  • process cancellations and refunds;
  • prevent payment abuse;
  • maintain billing records.

docs.title: 3.3 Security and Abuse Prevention
docs.text:
We may process information to:

  • detect fraudulent activity;
  • prevent unauthorized access;
  • investigate abuse;
  • protect the Service and its users;
  • identify technical or security incidents.

docs.title: 3.4 Service Improvement
docs.text:
We may use aggregated or otherwise appropriately protected information to understand how the Service is used and to improve:

  • functionality;
  • reliability;
  • matching and recommendation algorithms;
  • performance;
  • user experience.

docs.title: 3.5 Legal Compliance
docs.text:
We may process information where reasonably necessary to:

  • comply with applicable laws;
  • respond to lawful requests;
  • establish or defend legal claims;
  • enforce our Terms of Service;
  • protect our rights and legitimate interests.

docs.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
docs.text:
Where applicable data protection law requires a legal basis for processing personal information, we may rely on one or more of the following bases:

  • Performance of a contract — where processing is necessary to provide the Service or fulfill our contractual obligations.
  • Legitimate interests — where processing is necessary to operate, secure, improve, and protect the Service, provided that such interests are not overridden by applicable rights.
  • Consent — where we specifically request and obtain consent.
  • Legal obligation — where processing is required by applicable law.

The applicable legal basis may depend on the particular processing activity and the law applicable to you.

docs.title: 5. Information Sharing
docs.text:
We do not sell your personal information.

We may share information with third parties only where reasonably necessary to operate the Service or comply with applicable law.

Such third parties may include:

  • Telegram, which provides the communication and authentication platform used by the Service;
  • payment and billing providers;
  • hosting and infrastructure providers;
  • monitoring, logging, and technical service providers;
  • professional advisers;
  • governmental authorities where legally required.

Third-party providers are expected to process information in accordance with applicable contractual and legal requirements.

docs.title: 6. Telegram
docs.text:
Freelancer Digest operates through Telegram and relies on Telegram's infrastructure for certain functionality.

Your interactions with Telegram are also governed by Telegram's own terms, privacy policies, and technical practices.

We recommend reviewing Telegram's applicable policies separately.

We do not control how Telegram independently processes information within its own services.

docs.title: 7. Data Retention
docs.text:
We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy.

Retention periods may depend on:

  • the type of information;
  • the purpose for which it was collected;
  • whether you maintain an active account;
  • subscription and billing requirements;
  • security and fraud-prevention requirements;
  • applicable legal obligations.

When information is no longer reasonably required, we may delete it, anonymize it, or otherwise securely dispose of it.

Certain information may need to be retained for longer periods where required by law or reasonably necessary to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims.

docs.title: 8. Data Security
docs.text:
We take reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, destruction, or loss.

Depending on the nature of the information and the Service, these measures may include:

  • access controls;
  • authentication mechanisms;
  • encrypted connections;
  • logging and monitoring;
  • backups;
  • infrastructure security measures;
  • restrictions on access to personal information.

However, no internet-based service can guarantee absolute security.

You acknowledge that transmission and storage of information always involves some level of risk.

docs.title: 9. Your Rights
docs.text:
Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights regarding your personal information.

These rights may include:

  • the right to access your personal information;
  • the right to request correction of inaccurate information;
  • the right to request deletion;
  • the right to restrict certain processing;
  • the right to object to certain processing;
  • the right to data portability;
  • the right to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.

These rights are subject to applicable legal limitations and exceptions.

To exercise an applicable right, contact us using the information provided in the Contact section.

docs.title: 10. Account and Data Deletion
docs.text:
You may request deletion of your Freelancer Digest account and associated personal information.

Some information may need to be retained where required by law or reasonably necessary for:

  • fraud prevention;
  • security;
  • dispute resolution;
  • accounting or billing;
  • compliance with legal obligations;
  • establishment or defense of legal claims.

Deletion of your account does not necessarily result in immediate deletion of all information from backups or systems maintained for security and continuity purposes.

Such information will be deleted or overwritten in accordance with applicable retention procedures.

docs.title: 11. Cookies and Similar Technologies
docs.text:
